en: Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined street or lane leading over a small wooden bridge. Two people stand on the bridge, one holding a bicycle. On the left is a large villa‑like building; on the right, partly hidden by trees, is another multi‑story building with a small tower and clock. The scene is tranquil and semi‑rural. The printed title at the top reads "Graz. Leechgasse."
